remarks: Lovely, light, and bright three bedroom in Broad River! Welcome to this fantastic half duplex with three bedrooms at 30 1/2 Bartlett Ave. This is a second-floor (entire top floor!) unit with an updated bath and a beautiful kitchen with custom cabinetry, granite counters, and appliances, including a Bosch dishwasher. Enjoy the convenience of having private laundry and plenty of storage with pull-down stair access to the attic. Private front and rear entries include a shared patio, charming front yard, plus three dedicated off-street parking spots. Central air, natural gas, and all the conveniences of today. Easy commuter access to I95, Merritt, and the train. Close to the Norwalk River Valley trail and steps away from the park/playground, ball fields, and tennis courts, this beautiful, walkable neighborhood street is waiting for you! The tenant pays utilities. Landlord covers the water. 700+ credit score and references are required.  The owner requests an application, credit, and background checks.
